text:
maria_cs: FYI, onboarding ClearBox hit a weird pattern — their light client pings are causing preflight/auth token fanout and we end up with 429s from the gateway.
ollie_se: oof. are they using the browser SDK or our node lib?
maria_cs: browser SDK (v0.9.2). They said they call `start()` for every tab and haven't throttled the heartbeat.
jun_ml: can you paste the logs? curious about `x-rw-rl` headers and the heartbeat endpoint frequency.
maria_cs: snippet from their telemetry:

```
GET /v1/heartbeat 200 x-rw-rl: 100/1s
GET /v1/heartbeat 200 x-rw-rl: 100/1s
GET /v1/heartbeat 429 x-rw-rl: 0/1s
```

sam_support: so looks like 1s interval -> fanout across tabs -> token preflight spikes the per-key rate cap.
ops_infra: yep. default heartbeat in older SDKs was aggressive. We added jitter in 0.10.x but they are on 0.9.2.
maria_cs: they have 8 tabs open during onboarding demo. combined with ephemeral token refresh every 30s it becomes a stampede.
ollie_se: quick mitigation: set `heartbeatInterval: 30_000` and add exponential backoff on 429. Also prefer shared worker for multiple tabs.
jun_ml: also recommend turning off repeated preflight when visible=false and use keepalive pooling.
sam_support: told customer to update to 0.10.5 which has `heartbeatJitter` and `sharedSession` opt-in. they asked for a short-term server-side workaround.
ops_infra: server-side we can relax preflight for sandbox keys for 5m or bump the per-key concurrency for the trial tenant. but that dilutes rate guarantees.
maria_cs: customer prefers patch on our side for now — can we do a temporary per-tenant burst window increase for "clearbox-trial"?
ops_infra: I can add a 2x burst allowance for 15 minutes. will need approval from infra leads.
ollie_se: alternative: issue them an ephemeral onboarding test key with higher preflight rate. faster and safer.
sam_support: offered them the test key and instructions. also sent a config snippet:

```
// client init
const client = new RWSDK({
  heartbeatInterval: 30000, // 30s
  heartbeatJitter: 0.2, // +-20%
  sharedSession: true,
  onRateLimit: (meta) => { setTimeout(() => client.ping(), meta.retryAfter || 1000); }
});
```

maria_cs: customer confirmed reduced 429s after switching to test key + suggested config.
jun_ml: follow-up: add a small note to onboarding doc about multi-tab heartbeat and sharedWorker recommendation.
ops_infra: filed INF-7883 to give temporary burst for trial tenants; tagging infra leads for approval.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for sandbox config change at 2026-03-22T14:10:00Z :rocket:
sam_support: closing loop with ClearBox now. will monitor metrics for 1h and report back.
maria_cs: thanks team :thumbsup:
